name: sfsr-rems
description: OCR-Based Real Estate Management System for St. Francis Square Realty Corporation
//: SFSR-Portal and SFSR-Internal are independent projects with their own node_modules. This root package.json only holds maintenance scripts and shortcuts — it is NOT an npm workspace root.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix SFSR-Shared install && npm --prefix SFSR-Portal install && npm --prefix SFSR-Internal install
scripts.build: npm run build:portal && npm run build:internal
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix SFSR-Shared run typecheck && npm --prefix SFSR-Portal run typecheck && npm --prefix SFSR-Internal run typecheck && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.//reseed: Destructive. Run directly, not via npm — PowerShell drops the `--` so the required --yes flag never arrives: npx tsx scripts/reseedUnits.ts --yes
scripts.check:rules: tsx scripts/checkPortalQueries.ts && tsx scripts/checkTrippingRules.ts && tsx scripts/checkCancelRules.ts
scripts.deploy:portal: npm run build:portal && firebase deploy --only hosting --project sfsr-rems
